arm_score.how_to_read: mae_log10 is the primary loss. geometric_fold_error is the same quantity read as 'off by a factor of x on average'. mae_ml_per_min_per_kg is the back-transformed error in the endpoint's own units. The last two carry no separate test.
arm_score.native_units: pmol per million cells per minute

comparator_score.how_to_read: mae_log10 is the primary loss. geometric_fold_error is the same quantity read as 'off by a factor of x on average'. mae_ml_per_min_per_kg is the back-transformed error in the endpoint's own units. The last two carry no separate test.
comparator_score.native_units: pmol per million cells per minute

stored_error_bootstrap.what_this_interval_does_not_price: The draws resample the STORED out-of-fold per-donor errors; the components, the standardisation constants and the ridge penalty are not re-estimated inside each draw. The interval therefore carries the variability of the donors used for SCORING and not the variability of learning on 14 donors, so it is NARROWER than a fully nested bootstrap would be. It is a descriptive interval. A wider interval cannot turn a non-detection into a detection, so this understates the uncertainty of a POSITIVE finding more than that of a negative one.
stored_error_bootstrap.how_to_read: An interval containing zero means no difference was DETECTED. It is never a demonstration that there is none, and at n=15 the design's power is low by construction. The estimate and its uncertainty are the deliverable, not a significance verdict.

refitting_out_of_bag_bootstrap.scoring_donors_per_draw: the out-of-bag donors, about a third of 15
refitting_out_of_bag_bootstrap.what_this_interval_prices: both the choice of donors learned from and the choice of donors scored on, because each draw re-estimates the standardisation constants, the ridge penalty and the coefficients. It is the answer to the objection that the stored-error interval is narrower than a nested one.
refitting_out_of_bag_bootstrap.what_it_still_does_not_price: the choice of this cohort, this endpoint and these two predictors. No resampling of fifteen donors can price the fact that they are fifteen purchased hepatocyte lots of ages 1 to 63.

incremental_value_V3_vs_V1.which_interval_governs: the refitting one. Where they disagree, the stored-error interval is the optimistic reading and must not be quoted alone.

permutation_control.how_to_read: The null permutes the donor labels of the proteome block only, keeping the target CYP arm and the endpoint paired, and refits everything. It will not be centred on zero: the wider arm shrinks harder under an inner-CV penalty and so scores better with no information. An improvement inside the null is an artefact.

incremental_value_V3_vs_V1.verdict_rule: SUPPORTED requires all three: the REFITTING interval excludes zero, its point estimate is an improvement, and the permutation rank p-value is at most 0.05. The stored-error interval alone is never sufficient.

wegler_comparator.finding: the target CYP's own abundance predicted its substrate's intrinsic clearance out of sample for CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 after Bonferroni; midazolam's geometric fold error fell from 1.55 to 1.18
wegler_comparator.why_this_is_not_a_pooled_estimate: different donors, different laboratory and a different endpoint -- a fitted intrinsic clearance there, a single-concentration formation rate here. Two cohorts agreeing in direction is a replication of the direction, not one estimate measured twice.

what_this_cannot_claim.not_an_intrinsic_clearance: the endpoint is a formation rate at one substrate concentration. It is not Vmax/Km, not a fitted CLint, and not comparable to Wegler's equation 7 on the same scale.
what_this_cannot_claim.not_a_pharmacokinetic_result: no dose, no plasma drug concentration, no exposure. A gain here says nothing about predicting a concentration, an AUC or a clearance in a patient.
what_this_cannot_claim.not_a_clinical_biomarker_validation: the plasma came from deceased organ donors at procurement. A 4-beta-hydroxycholesterol ratio measured there is not interchangeable with one measured in a living patient.
what_this_cannot_claim.two_substrates_are_not_two_cohorts: midazolam and ibrutinib were measured in the same fifteen donors. The second endpoint is a second reading of one cohort.
what_this_cannot_claim.absence_of_a_gain_is_not_equivalence: at fifteen donors an interval that contains zero means no difference was detected. The estimate and its width are the result; a verdict of 'no difference' is not available.
